summary: Certified Nursing Assistant with over eleven years of progressive experience in skilled nursing, assisted living, and home health settings. Provides primary resident care, activities of daily living support, vital sign monitoring for large patient floors, and body mechanics and safety-focused patient handling, including mechanical lifts and sliding board transfers. Experienced in caring for patients with chronic conditions such as COPD, asthma, and cardiac disorders, supporting patient education, quality assurance programs, and onboarding of new staff. Holds Pennsylvania CNA licensure and a background in visual communications and computer technology, with web design and programming coursework.
